title: Maurya
desc: Manu, a kick-boxer must train and win an upcoming tournament to fulfill his mother's wishes and to become the best in the world.

title: Damarukam
desc: After a demon born from darkness plans to take over the world, a man decides to take matters into his hands and fight to save his beloved.

title: Odahuttidavaru
desc: Two brothers live in harmony. However, their relationship soon begins to fall apart when the younger brother's wife starts creating clashes between them.

title: Hello
desc: A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a money-lender. However, tables turn when she loses her property and they fall in love.
